name: Quarterly DPIA Refresh
description: Runs quarterly, pulls the current risk register, has an AI agent analyse changes and update the DPIA, then notifies the compliance team to review.

config.goal: Review the current risk register and identify: (1) new data processing activities requiring DPIA assessment, (2) changes to existing high-risk activities, (3) residual risks above threshold. Risk register: ${nodes['pull-risks'].output}. Return structured DPIA update with sections: newActivities, changedActivities, residualRisks, recommendedMitigations.

config.title: Q${Math.ceil((new Date().getMonth()+1)/3)} DPIA Refresh Ready
